entity.description: One audit run a tenant has set up, e.g. gorjana's "Month close": its statements, checked each period.

field.name: auditId
field.description: Globally unique row id, e.g. GORJANA_MONTH_CLOSE. Never shown; the JSON uses auditCode.

field.name: auditCode
field.description: Kebab-case slug, e.g. month-close. The JSON audit id; unique per tenant.

field.name: auditName
field.description: The audit's display name, e.g. Month close.

field.name: periodEnumId
field.description: AuditPeriod: the period a run's checked day is reported under (report.period), day, month or quarter.

field.name: recentReadDays
field.description: DAR-BE-116. How many days, up to the run's last day, the audit reads from HotWax OMS (whose API is rate-limited) instead of the whole period. On a check pairing OMS with another system, that system is read from AuditRecentReadSupport.EDGE_SLACK_DAYS earlier, and a record only it holds is judged only when its own date (AuditCheck.otherSideDateField) is EDGE_SLACK_DAYS or more into those days, so an older one neither raises nor closes a finding. Checks between other systems keep the whole period. Empty or zero: read OMS for the whole period.

entity.description: DAR-BE-091. A user's ask that one ended period of an audit keeps running: each morning through continueThruDate, that period's checks re-read the whole period beside the new period's own run, so its open findings can still close. No row: the period stops at its last day and its findings stay as they are.

field.name: period
field.description: The period kept running, in the audit's period form: 2026-10 (month), 2026-Q4, 2026-10-14 (day).

field.name: continueThruDate
field.description: The last morning the period still runs, after the period's own last day.

entity.description: One thing a tenant needs to be true at month end, in the tenant's own words, e.g. gorjana's R4 "Every refund we give a customer is booked in NetSuite at the same amount...".

field.name: statementId
field.description: Globally unique row id, e.g. GORJANA_R4. Never shown; the JSON uses statementCode.

field.name: auditId
field.description: DAR-BE-103. The audit the statement belongs to.

field.name: statementCode
field.description: The tenant's label for the statement, e.g. R4. The JSON statement id; unique within its audit.

field.name: categoryEnumId
field.description: Enumeration of type AuditCategory; its enumCode is the JSON category id.

field.name: weightEnumId
field.description: Enumeration of type AuditStatementWeight: firm (the tenant said it) or derived (inferred from production problems, awaiting the tenant's confirmation).

field.name: statementText
field.description: The statement verbatim, in the tenant's words.

field.name: isActive
field.description: DAR-UI-063. N turns the statement off: it leaves the report and its checks record no findings for it. Blank or Y is on, so rows from before the field read on.

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: Order of statements in the report.

entity.description: One check that tests one or more statements, usually a saved run on a daily schedule. Its findings land on the ledger (DAR-BE-089) under this check. The three templates are plain text with {name} placeholders, replaced literally from the finding's fields; they are NEVER expanded as Groovy or FTL, because tenant configuration must not be able to run code.

field.name: checkId
field.description: Globally unique row id. Never shown; the JSON uses checkCode.

field.name: checkCode
field.description: Kebab-case slug, e.g. returns-vs-credit-memos. The JSON check id; unique per tenant.

field.name: label
field.description: What the check compares, in a few words.

field.name: savedRunId
field.description: The saved run (RuleSet) that executes the check. Blank until the run is configured.

field.name: automationId
field.description: DAR-BE-092. The scheduled automation that runs this check. When set, that automation reads the audit's windows (get#AuditWindow: the period to date, plus any extended period) instead of its own, and after each window writes the check's health, findings and closings to the ledger.

field.name: file1RecordType
field.description: DAR-BE-092. The contract record type of a FILE_1 record, e.g. return; blank reads as record.

field.name: file2RecordType
field.description: DAR-BE-092. The contract record type of a FILE_2 record, e.g. creditMemo.

field.name: graceDays
field.description: Days a new finding stays pending before it counts as open. Blank means 0.

field.name: otherSideDateField
field.description: DAR-BE-116. On a check comparing HotWax OMS with another system: the date field on the OTHER system's record (e.g. tranDate on a NetSuite RMA, createdAt on a Shopify order) that says whether a record only that system holds falls in the audit's recent OMS read (Audit.recentReadDays). Empty: such records are not judged while OMS is read for fewer days than the period.

field.name: matchedBy
field.description: The shared id the two sides join on, in words, e.g. "return id (custbody_hc_return_id)". Blank for a one-sided check.

field.name: fixOwner
field.description: The team that fixes this check's findings, e.g. HotWax Support.

field.name: fixWhereEnumId
field.description: The ROOT system where the fix is made (OMS, NETSUITE or SHOPIFY of type DarpanSystemSource), never an endpoint.

field.name: headlineTemplate
field.description: One-line finding headline, e.g. "Credit memo is {differenceAbs} less than the refund for return {returnId}". At most 120 characters once filled, no trailing period.

field.name: fixActionTemplate
field.description: What to change, filled with the finding's values.

field.name: passesWhenTemplate
field.description: What the next scheduled check must see for the finding to close.

field.name: amountCurrencyUomId
field.description: DAR-BE-095. Set when this check's rule compares money: a FIELD_MISMATCH row's file 1 value is the finding's expected amount and its file 2 value the actual one, in this currency (evidence.expected, .actual, .difference). Blank: the values are not money (a customer id, a day number).

field.name: expectedSource
field.description: Where the expected amount comes from, e.g. "Warranty claim (RMA total)".

field.name: actualSource
field.description: Where the actual amount comes from, e.g. "NetSuite credit memo total".

entity.description: Which check tests which statement. Many-to-many: one comparison serves several statements (returns against credit memos covers R4, R6, R7, R8, R9, R14 and R16), and one statement can need two checks (R1: invoiced orders and cash sales). Stamped with the tenant like both parents, so the filter applies to it directly.

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: Order of a statement's checks in the report.

field.name: diffTypes
field.description: DAR-BE-092. Which rows of the check's run break this statement: comma-separated diff row types, e.g. MISSING_IN_FILE_2 or FINDING. Blank: every row.

field.name: conclusionCodes
field.description: DAR-BE-092. Narrows the rows to these conclusion codes (comma-separated). Blank: any conclusion, or none.

field.name: ruleIds
field.description: DAR-BE-095. Narrows the rows to those these rules raised (comma-separated rule ids, the FIELD_MISMATCH row's ruleId), so one compare with several field rules serves several statements. Blank: any rule, or none.

entity.description: One record that breaks one statement, as found by one check. Identity is (tenant, check, statement, recordKey): the same record found again on a later morning is the same finding, and one record that breaks two statements of one check is two findings.

field.name: findingId
field.description: F-<n>. The stored id and the JSON id are the same string.

field.name: recordKey
field.description: The check's key for the record, e.g. the OMS return id; stable across mornings.

field.name: period
field.description: DAR-BE-091. The period whose run found it, e.g. 2026-10: each period of an audit is its own run and report, and an extended October keeps running beside November.

field.name: stateEnumId
field.description: AuditFindingState: AUDFS_PENDING inside the check's grace age, AUDFS_OPEN after it, AUDFS_FIXED once a complete check looked at the record and no longer reported it.

field.name: firstFoundDate
field.description: The morning (tenant calendar day) a check first reported it. Kept when the finding reopens.

field.name: lastSeenDate
field.description: The latest morning a check still reported it.

field.name: lastCheckedStamp
field.description: When a check last looked at the record, whether or not it reported it.

field.name: timesSeen
field.description: Mornings on which a check reported it, counting the first.

field.name: closedByTypeEnumId
field.description: AuditActorType of what closed it; in v1 always AUDAT_CHECK.

field.name: closedById
field.description: The check (checkId) that closed it.

field.name: differenceAmount
field.description: actualAmount - expectedAmount; blank when either side is blank.

field.name: ruleText
field.description: The exact condition the record failed, in plain words.

field.name: conclusionEnumId
field.description: DarpanConclusion reached for the record; blank when no conclusion rule matched.

field.name: diagnosisText
field.description: DAR-BE-090. One sentence on what the conclusion means for this record; the finding JSON's diagnosis.explanation. Blank falls back to the conclusion's description.

entity.description: One id of the finding in one system. Replaced on every sighting, so it always shows what the latest check read.

field.name: systemEnumId
field.description: The ROOT system (OMS, NETSUITE, SHOPIFY of DarpanSystemSource), resolved through parentEnumId when the row is written; never an endpoint such as OMS_RETURNS_GQL.

field.name: recordType
field.description: camelCase singular, e.g. return, creditMemo, rma (contract "Records").

field.name: recordId
field.description: The id a person searches by, e.g. a NetSuite tranId or an OMS returnId.

field.name: internalId
field.description: The system's own key when it differs from recordId.

field.name: recordStatus
field.description: The record's status in its own system's words, when the check read it.

entity.description: One sub-condition of the finding's evidence, in order. Replaced on every sighting.

field.name: checkValue
field.description: What was seen, e.g. "160.22 vs 160.23".

entity.description: One row of a finding's history: found, stillOpen, fixed or reopened. Append-only.

field.name: eventDate
field.description: The morning (tenant calendar day) of the event; a past report reads state from the last event on or before its date.

entity.description: One check on one morning for one period. A second run the same morning replaces the first (unique on tenant, check, period and reportDate), so the report always shows the latest run.

field.name: reportDate
field.description: The morning the check ran, as a tenant calendar day.

field.name: period
field.description: DAR-BE-091. The period this run checked, e.g. 2026-10. On Nov 3 an extended October and November are two runs of one check.

field.name: windowFromDate
field.description: DAR-BE-091. First day the check's window covered (tenant calendar day): the start of the audit's period, so every open finding of the period is examined again each morning.

field.name: windowThruDate
field.description: Last day the check's window covered, inclusive: the report day itself ("on the 14th it reconciles 1-14").

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: AuditCheckStatus derived from the reads: AUDCS_RAN when every read was complete, AUDCS_PARTIAL when any was partial or failed, AUDCS_NOT_RUN when the check did not run.

field.name: reason
field.description: Why the check was partial or did not run, in plain words; blank when it ran.

field.name: runStamp
field.description: When the run was recorded.

entity.description: One extract a check run made from one system, and how it ended.

field.name: systemEnumId
field.description: The ROOT system (OMS, NETSUITE, SHOPIFY), resolved through parentEnumId when written.

field.name: endpointEnumId
field.description: The endpoint that read it, e.g. OMS_RETURNS_GQL, as given by the run.

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: AuditSourceRead: AUDSR_COMPLETE, AUDSR_PARTIAL or AUDSR_FAILED.

field.name: recordCount
field.description: Records read; blank when the read failed before counting.

field.name: readStamp
field.description: When the read finished; blank when it failed.

field.name: reason
field.description: Why the read was partial or failed, in plain words; blank when complete.

entity.description: DAR-BE-102. One chat message an audit sends on a schedule, rendered from that morning's report JSON and nothing else: a daily digest for the team that fixes records, a weekly summary for the team that closes the books. A tenant may have several per audit, each to its own chat space.

field.name: chatSpaceId
field.description: The tenant's chat space it posts to (TenantChatSpace); another tenant's space is never used. Blank: email only.

field.name: emailAddresses
field.description: Comma-separated addresses it is emailed to (template DARPAN_AUDIT_DIGEST). A digest needs a chat space, addresses, or both (Aditi, 2026-10-22: "either email or chat alerts").

field.name: kindEnumId
field.description: AuditDigestKind: daily (open, new and fixed today) or weekly (where things stand against a week before).

field.name: sendTime
field.description: HH:mm in the tenant's zone, after the morning's checks, e.g. 07:00 for checks at 06:00.

field.name: dayOfWeek
field.description: Weekly only: ISO day, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday.

field.name: fullList
field.description: Y lists every open and pending finding, as far as one message holds, for the days before a close; otherwise only the oldest open ones.

field.name: lastSentDate
field.description: The tenant's day it last went out; at most one message a day, claimed before it is sent.
